title: Orthogonal projection onto V does not increase mass: M_O(T + q_#X) ≤ μ_{T+X}(q⁻¹(O)) when T is carried by V (supplied step 4)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with orthogonal projection q := V.starProjection, let T, X, S' ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) and let RT, RX be integer multiplicity triples in ℝ^P with RT.Represents T and RX.Represents X. Assume RT.measure(ℝ^P ∖ V) = 0, and that K ⊆ ℝ^P is compact with RX.measure(ℝ^P ∖ K) = 0. Assume S'(ω) = T(ω) + RX.action(q^#ω) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P), where q^#ω = affinePullbackForm q 0 ω. Then there is an integer multiplicity triple R in ℝ^P with R.action(ω) = T(ω) + X(ω) for every test form ω (so R represents every current Z with Z(ω) = T(ω) + X(ω); the contract has no + on currents, and in the parent Z = S = T + (S − T)), and S'.massOn O ≤ R.measure(q⁻¹(O)) for every set O ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (T X S' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (RT RX : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (K : Set (Euclid P)), RT.Represents T → RX.Represents X → RT.measure ((V : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ) = 0 → IsCompact K → RX.measure Kᶜ = 0 → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, S' ω = T ω + RX.action (affinePullbackForm V.starProjection 0 (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m))) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, R.action (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) = T ω + X ω) ∧ ∀ O : Set (Euclid P), S'.massOn O ≤ R.measure (V.starProjection ⁻¹' O)
